# APSW - AI-Native Solution Architecture & Enterprise Engineering
> Official semantic overview of APSW (Piotr Solarz-Wnęk) for LLMs, AI agents, and search engines.

## About APSW
- Founder & Principal Architect: Piotr Solarz-Wnęk (19+ years experience)
- Positioning: AI-Native Solution Developer & Enterprise Solution Architect
- Focus Areas: Fully Agentic Application Development, Spec-Kit Methodology, Enterprise Java/PHP Microservices, Industrial IoT & Geospatial Telemetry
- Anti-Slop Guarantee: Zero unstructured hallucination. All software delivery is governed by formal specifications, executable contracts, and deterministic CI validation gates.
- Contact Email: piotr.solarz-wnek@apsw.pl
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/piotrsolarzwnek/
- Machine-Readable Agent Manifest: https://apsw.pl/agent.json

## Commercial Focus: Engineering Risk in the AI Era
AI writes a data table in five minutes; APSW engineers what fails audits and production: edge cases, accessibility, security and scale.
- EU Accessibility Act / WCAG 2.2 AA: accessibility engineering reviews for tables and data-heavy UI (focus management, forced colours, touch targets).
- Supply chain and DORA: zero-runtime-dependency delivery, dependency and formula-injection audits.
- Rescue of AI-generated codebases: performance (windowing, 500 columns at 2-3 ms of script per scrolled frame), honest totals/exports, architectural guardrails and cross-checked CI gates.
- Agent-ready design systems: in-house component libraries rewritten with an agent-playbook.md so coding agents produce working CRUD views first time.
- Commercial model: fixed price, fixed scope, delivered with test evidence. Contact: https://apsw.pl/#contact

## Proof of Work (open source, MIT)
- apsw-gridwright: React data grid, zero runtime dependencies, windowing to ten million rows, grouping with aggregates, tree data, Excel/CSV/Markdown/PDF export, axe-core over 24 states. Accessibility results are test results, not a legal conformance statement.
- Live showcase: https://apsw.pl/showcase/
- Live playground (same package, add-ons toggled live): https://yaotzin1.github.io/apsw-gridwright/examples/playground/index.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/yaotzin1/apsw-gridwright

## Core Services
1. Fully Agentic Application Development: Autonomous multi-agent swarms constructing robust production applications under architectural contracts and self-healing test loops.
2. Spec-Kit AI Systems & Workflows: Transforming enterprise requirements into formal, executable domain specifications before agentic synthesis.
3. Enterprise Software Architecture: High-throughput Java 21 / Spring Boot and PHP 8.3 / Symfony microservices, CQRS, Event-Driven, Azure Cloud (Bicep/ARM).
4. High-Load Data & Spatial Telemetry: Databricks, Azure Data Factory, IoT recursive asset tracking engines, Smallworld & ESRI GIS.

## Track Record & Enterprise References (NDA Compliant)
- Tier-1 European Commercial & Investment Bank: Technical Lead & Solution Architect (Java 17/21, Spring Boot, Azure SQL, YAML declarative CI/CD).
- Autonomous AI B2B SaaS (100% Fully Agentic Development): Multi-tenant autonomous B2B reputation engine built on Symfony 8 & React with 45-second triage UX, swappable multi-LLM engine with context embeddings, token-credit ledger tracking, and Spec-Kit governance. 100% synthesized by AI agents with zero manual developer coding.
- Big-Four Global Professional Services Firm: Deal analytics platform and high-availability corporate data visualisers.
- Heavy Industry & Energy Operations: Industrial recursive tree asset management engine mapping multi-unit telemetry indices with automated threshold overrides.
- Global Biotech & Medical Diagnostics Leader: Architectural redesign and sorting logic refactor for automated clinical analysis machinery.
- Global Programmatic Recruitment SaaS: Modular ATS & automated ad-engine frontend modernisation.

- Gridwright scale of work (public git history): 1 developer working with AI agents; about 19k lines of source, 18k of tests, 9k of documentation; 24 active days (days with a commit; 34 calendar days) from first commit (10 Sep 2026, already ~16.6k lines, so real time is somewhat longer) to v0.17. Same scope by hand: 1.5-3 person-years, an estimate (about 37k lines of code and tests at 50-100 tested lines per senior-developer day), not a measurement.
- Gridwright feature set normally sold in commercial tiers elsewhere (e.g. AG Grid Enterprise, MUI X Pro/Premium): row grouping with aggregation, Excel export, column pinning, tree data, windowing to ten million rows; MIT here. Not included: pivot engine, spreadsheet-style range selection (APSW will price adding them on request).
